sharps.do1: Pick up only with tongs or thick gloves.
sharps.do2: Put in a hard, closed container (bottle or can).
sharps.dont1: Do not touch with bare hands.
sharps.dont2: Do not press, bend, or open it.
sharps.dont3: Do not throw in open waste.

glass.do1: Use thick gloves or a scoop to pick up.
glass.do2: Wrap pieces tightly in paper or cloth.
glass.dont1: Do not pick up with bare hands.
glass.dont2: Do not shake or drop it further.

batteries.do1: Place in a separate, dry container.
batteries.do2: Keep away from heat and water.
batteries.do3: Report leaking or swollen batteries immediately.
batteries.dont1: Do not crush, burn, or open.
batteries.dont2: Do not touch a leaking battery — report it.

chemicals.do2: Store upright and separate from other waste.
chemicals.dont1: Do not open, sniff, or mix chemicals.
chemicals.dont2: Do not let it touch skin or eyes.

medical.do1: Wash hands well after any contact.
medical.dont1: Do not touch with bare hands.
medical.dont2: Do not open bags or containers.
medical.dont3: Do not put in regular waste.

general.do2: Wear gloves if you have them.
general.do3: Sort it for recycling if possible.
general.dont1: Do not mix recyclables with wet waste.

unknown.do2: Use a tool or stick to move it if needed.
unknown.do3: Ask a supervisor or report it.
unknown.dont2: Do not try to identify it yourself.
unknown.dont3: Treat it as dangerous until you know what it is.
